---
title: "Fixed 26-week death — computationally reduced supporting/sensitivity analysis (5 imputations)"
format: html
execute:
  freeze: false
---

This computationally reduced supporting/sensitivity analysis (5 imputations)
fits an unadjusted binary death model at day 182 using fixed imputations 1–5.
Two hundred posterior draws per imputation are retained for the difference in
death risk.

```{r}
#| label: setup
#| include: false
source(here::here("R", "analysis-config.R"))
source(here::here("R", "paths-artifacts.R"))
source(here::here("R", "checkpoints.R"))
source(here::here("analysis", "module-runtime.R"))
runtime <- module_runtime()
config <- runtime$config
indices <- module_exact_indices(config, supporting = TRUE)
if (!identical(indices, 1:5)) stop("Supporting fixed-death analysis requires exactly imputations 1:5.")
data_dir <- project_path("artifacts", "primary", "overall-survival", "imputations")
output_dir <- ensure_directory(project_path("artifacts", "supporting", "os-fixed-26-week-death"))
code_paths <- module_code_paths(
  here::here("R", "analysis-config.R"),
  here::here("R", "checkpoints.R"),
  here::here("analysis", "module-runtime.R"), knitr::current_input()
)
```

```{r}
#| label: fit-fixed-death
#| include: false
for (index in indices) {
  data_path <- file.path(data_dir, sprintf("imputation-%02d.parquet", index))
  model_path <- file.path(output_dir, sprintf("model-%02d.rds", index))
  draws_path <- file.path(output_dir, sprintf("draws-%02d.parquet", index))
  if (!file.exists(data_path)) stop("Missing fixed OS imputation ", index, ".")
  module_branch(
    runtime = runtime,
    stage_id = sprintf("supporting-os-fixed-death-%02d", index),
    input_paths = data_path,
    output_paths = c(model_path, draws_path),
    code_paths = code_paths,
    metadata = list(label = "computationally reduced supporting/sensitivity analysis (5 imputations)",
                   imputation = index, imputations = 1:5, posterior_draws = 200L,
                   horizon_days = 182L),
    worker = function() {
      data <- module_read_parquet(data_path)
      model <- rstanarm::stan_glm(
        event_death ~ tx,
        data = data,
        family = stats::binomial(),
        chains = 4,
        iter = 1000,
        warmup = 500,
        cores = 4,
        seed = analysis_seed(config, "supporting", index)
      )
      posterior <- as.matrix(model)
      if (nrow(posterior) < 200L) stop("Fixed-death posterior has fewer than 200 draws.")
      posterior <- posterior[seq_len(200L), , drop = FALSE]
      intercept <- posterior[, "(Intercept)"]
      treatment <- posterior[, "tx"]
      draws <- data.frame(
        draw = seq_len(200L),
        death_risk_control = stats::plogis(intercept),
        death_risk_sat = stats::plogis(intercept + treatment),
        death_risk_difference = stats::plogis(intercept + treatment) - stats::plogis(intercept),
        imputation = index,
        stringsAsFactors = FALSE
      )
      module_save_rds(model, model_path)
      module_save_parquet(draws, draws_path)
    }
  )
}
```
